name: bruce-drawio
description: Cross-platform draw.io diagram generation skill by bruc3van: flowcharts, architecture, UML, ER, mindmaps and network topologies. The agent writes drawio XML directly, validates it, then exports PNG/SVG/PDF via CLI (falls back to an app.diagrams.net link).

description_i18n.en: Cross-platform draw.io diagram generation skill by bruc3van: flowcharts, architecture, UML, ER, mindmaps and network topologies. The agent writes drawio XML directly, validates it, then exports PNG/SVG/PDF via CLI (falls back to an app.diagrams.net link).
description_i18n.zh-CN: bruc3van 的跨平台 draw.io 图表生成技能：流程图、架构图、UML 时序/类图、ER 图、思维导图、网络拓扑。Agent 直接生成 drawio XML，校验后 CLI 导出 PNG/SVG/PDF，无桌面版时自动降级为 app.diagrams.net 在线链接。
